authority: Integers are exempt from the cast — jsonata-js's replacer is guarded by !Number.isInteger(val) and jsntrs' string_cast_number by n.fract() != 0.0 — so this value takes the exact JSON path and the answer is ECMAScript ToString of the double, unrounded. The case exists to pin the boundary of the cast described in docs/spec.md 4.2.6. The exponential spellings are ECMAScript ToString's own thresholds — 1e-7 and 5e-7 straddle the small-number boundary, 1e21 and 1e22 the large one (docs/behaviors.md 1.4).
